subject: objections to truecap, handled
preheader: i hear the same three things. here are honest answers.
headline: Three honest pushbacks on TrueCap, and what I'd say back.
body: "I already have a spreadsheet." Sure — most serious investors do, and a good one is genuinely powerful. The question is how long it takes. If your spreadsheet does cap rate, DSCR, NOI, 10-year projection, sensitivity, and pulls rent comps, you spent 30-45 minutes on it per deal. TrueCap does that in 60 seconds. Use both. Use the spreadsheet for the deals that survive the 60-second pass.

"I trust my gut." Gut works for location, condition, and tenant quality. Gut does not work for DSCR. I've seen experienced investors miss DSCR by 0.15+ in their head because they didn't model real lender rates against real NOI. The numbers don't argue with you. They just are.

"$20 a month is too expensive." If you're buying one rental every two years, fair — use the free tier. If you analyze five deals a week, you spend at least an hour a day on underwriting. $20/mo to compress that to 30 minutes a day is hourly math that always works.
Free tier is free forever, no card, no trial. Pro is month-to-month, cancel anytime. There's no lock-in to be skeptical about.
